verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.vonage.com, returning HTTP 200 and describing Vonage Communication APIs including video. The file carries Video-specific guidance such as TokBox/OpenTok migration and JWT token access, so an agent can be pointed at it directly, which satisfies the story's 'llms.txt or agent-oriented docs' requirement. The llms.txt is shared across all Vonage communication APIs rather than dedicated to Video, and the probe found no per-page markdown docs (create-session.md returned 404). missing for 10: per-page markdown/agent-readable doc variants, a Video-dedicated agent docs index, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
